voice.name: Brian - Deep, Resonant and Comforting
voice.why: Bruno runs the crew at Coalman's Brow: big, slow and sure of himself. Brian is a deep, resonant American baritone, a long way from the mill foreman's lighter laid-back drawl and from every islander voice already cast.

greet.text: Bruno. I run the crew at Coalman's Brow. Swing a pick, keep your head down, and the mine will notice you.

next_top.text: You have seen every door this mine has. The rest is just coal, friend.
